LAYOUT: All four panels are present and correctly placed: top-left (causal chain), top-right (recorded series), bottom-left (bit strip), bottom-right (state card).
SERIES: The line plot shows 4 series (w, delta w, gradient, loss) in the legend. However, the plot area is nearly empty; only a single horizontal orange line is visible near the bottom (y ≈ 0.1). No data points or line trends for the other series are visible. A purple circular marker is visible at the far left edge (x=0, y≈0.95).
TEXT: Step: 95 / 199; w: 1.4991327524161818; Loss: 3.486945331763404e-09; FPS: 21 (top-right) and 25 (state card); Bits changed: 18 of 32; Hex: 0x3FBEE395.
BITS: 32 bit squares are drawn. The orange squares (representing changed bits) correspond to the exponent and the start of the mantissa (approximately bits 9 through 26). The hex word is 0x3FBEE395.
DEFECTS: The "recorded series" panel is effectively empty of plotted data series despite the legend; the purple marker is pinned to the left border; the state card text for "delta" and "attempted" is slightly crowded/overlapping with its parenthetical notes.
VERDICT: FAIL (The primary data visualization panel "recorded series" fails to render the actual time-series lines or data points, showing only a baseline and a marker).
